description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Revision of the Conditions Setout in the Excise Notification No.666 (Amendment)
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory instrument issued under the Excise Ordinance. It amends previous excise notifications by revising specific conditions and repealing a sub-paragraph. The content focuses on regulatory changes to excise laws rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only listing his title), and the primary purpose is regulatory amendment, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) rather than a government personnel type.
